# Introduction to Computer Vision

Weizmann course 20274111 (Basri, Bagon, Galun, Irani). Covers basic topics in computer vision, image processing, and human vision: Fourier analysis, 3D shape recovery from stereo images, motion and video analysis, illumination, object recognition, and supervised machine learning in the context of vision.

Grading: assignments 40–50%, final exam 50–60%.

The `lecture-notes` skill (`shared/.github/skills/lecture-notes/SKILL.md`) has the full workflow for reading handwritten lecture notes.
